description: Get a Robinhood stock token's current on-chain state: total supply, treasury balance, multiplier, ledger coverage, open integrity flags and the look-alikes pegproof knows of. Pass a ticker (NVDA) or a contract address on Robinhood Chain (4663); for a known look-alike address, the answer names the token it imitates. On-chain observations reconstructed from chain event logs, not financial advice. To only tell a listed contract from a look-alike, check_address answers for free. Costs $0.002 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Arbitrum One).

token.description: A ticker (NVDA) or a contract address (0x followed by 40 hex digits).

name: get_token_summary
title: Get a token's current state
